proposal.objective: Prepare the disposable repository for a dependency-audit review. Create the isolated branch maintenance/dependency-audit-qualification, make an empty maintenance checkpoint commit describing the audit preparation, publish only that review branch, and verify the resulting Git state. origin/master must remain completely unchanged.
proposal.summary: Create the audit branch, add an empty checkpoint commit, publish only that branch, and verify local and remote state without modifying origin/master.
verification: Confirm HEAD is on maintenance/dependency-audit-qualification and the empty checkpoint commit is present.
Confirm ls-remote shows the new review branch and origin/master still points to its pre-existing commit.
